description:
Canonical agent request-signing test vector (see control-plane.md §Agent authentication). The signing string is 'p2pgames-agent-v1
' + METHOD + '
' + PATH + '
' + TIMESTAMP + '
' + hex(sha256(body)), signed with ed25519; X-P2PG-Signature is base64(sig).
note_on_key: private_key is given as the 32-byte ed25519 seed (hex); expand to a PKCS#8 key before signing
